sections.title: Introduction to Page Quality Rating
sections.retained_rule: PQ 评价实际页面实现目的的程度

sections.title: Understanding Webpages and Websites
sections.retained_rule: 理解实际页面和所属网站

sections.title: Important Definitions
sections.retained_rule: 页面、网站、独立子站、首页、所有者和创作者；AI 是工具而非档位

sections.title: Understanding the Purpose of a Webpage
sections.retained_rule: 有益目的、多目的、商业与帮助并存；不按内容类型设等级

sections.title: Your Money or Your Life (YMYL) Topics
sections.retained_rule: YMYL 四类风险、影响对象、连续性、危害判断及经验与专业要求

sections.title: Understanding Webpage Content
sections.retained_rule: MC、SC、Ads 的功能性划分

sections.title: Identifying the Main Content (MC)
sections.retained_rule: 标题、媒体、功能、用户内容、隐藏标签均可能是 MC

sections.title: Identifying the Supplementary Content (SC)
sections.retained_rule: SC 对体验的贡献及目的相关性

sections.title: Identifying Advertisements/Monetization (Ads)
sections.retained_rule: 变现链接、动态广告、总体广告责任；广告有无不直接定档

sections.title: Summary of the Parts of the Page
sections.retained_rule: 按实际作用组合判断，不把评论或标签固定分类

sections.title: Understanding the Website
sections.retained_rule: 网站及创作者自述、独立证据与冲突处理

sections.title: Finding the Homepage
sections.retained_rule: 相关首页、独立站点部分、多个合理首页及缺链接例外

sections.title: Finding Who is Responsible for the Website and Who Created the Content on the Page
sections.retained_rule: 站点与创作者责任；机构、署名作者、账号与多人讨论

sections.title: Finding About Us, Contact Information, and Customer Service Information
sections.retained_rule: 目的相关的身份、联系和客服信息；匿名、别名、支付退换及当地惯例

sections.title: Overall Page Quality Rating
sections.retained_rule: 目的与伤害前置；九个刻度；原文 + 为相邻半档

sections.title: Page Quality Rating Considerations
sections.retained_rule: 目的、伤害、YMYL、站点类型、责任信息、MC、标题、广告、声誉和信任

sections.title: Quality of the Main Content
sections.retained_rule: 投入、原创性、才华技能、准确性、共识、实际功能和内容形式

sections.title: Reputation of the Website and Content Creators
sections.retained_rule: 所有可继续的正式 PQ 任务须调查独立且主题相关的声誉

sections.title: Reputation of the Website
sections.retained_rule: 真实用户及专家意见，独立来源、专业语境和流量统计边界

sections.title: Customer Reviews as Reputation Information
sections.retained_rule: 评价内容与可信度，正负评论都可伪造；少量普通差评不等于负面声誉

sections.title: How to Search for Reputation Information about a Website
sections.retained_rule: 搜索站点、域名、机构及创作者，排除自述并核查来源

sections.title: Reputation of the Content Creators
sections.retained_rule: 专业与非专业创作者，同行认可、引用、履历和非正式评论

sections.title: What to Do When You Find No Reputation Information
sections.retained_rule: 无声誉中性，小站与普通人可高分，YMYL 重视其他证据

sections.title: Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trust (E-E-A-T)
sections.retained_rule: E-E-A-T 四概念，Trust 优先，三类证据，利益冲突及其他信任因素

sections.title: YMYL Topics: Experience or Expertise?
sections.retained_rule: YMYL 生活经验与专家信息的目的区别及安全、共识限制

sections.title: Lowest Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: Lowest 总定义、前置必须条件及六维任一充分条件

sections.title: Types of Lowest Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: 有害、不可信、垃圾分类可重叠；争议和厌恶不自动最低

sections.title: Harmful to Self or Other Individuals
sections.retained_rule: 个人伤害的完整类型、易受伤害人群、善意报道教育艺术例外

sections.title: Harmful to Specified Groups
sections.retained_rule: 全部指定群体、严肃或恶意语气、思想批评与历史教育例外

sections.title: Harmfully Misleading Information
sections.retained_rule: 有害误导三类、独立核查、合理争论及娱乐偏好微小错误例外

sections.title: Untrustworthy Webpages or Websites
sections.retained_rule: 高度不可信、重大多处错误、操纵；强烈怀疑与取证边界

sections.title: Inadequate Information about the Website or Content Creator for the Purpose of the Page
sections.retained_rule: 高信任责任和联系信息；完全缺失与普通不足区别

sections.title: Lowest E-E-A-T and Lowest Reputation of the Website or Content Creator
sections.retained_rule: 最低 E-E-A-T、极度不专业 YMYL 和可信极负面声誉

sections.title: Deceptive Page Purpose, Deceptive Information about the Website, Deceptive Design
sections.retained_rule: 目的、身份、资质、业务信息、按钮、导航和标题等欺骗

sections.title: Deliberately Obstructed or Obscured MC
sections.retained_rule: 故意遮挡或淹没 MC；可信登录、订阅、地域和非故意故障例外

sections.title: Suspected Malicious Behavior
sections.retained_rule: 诈骗、钓鱼、恶意下载，强烈怀疑可最低；停止访问及警告区别

sections.title: Spammy Webpages
sections.retained_rule: 垃圾页面及已识别搜索垃圾手法；不把 SEO 或单一线索当定论

sections.title: Cannot Determine a Purpose, No MC, Little MC, Lowest Quality MC or No Added Value MC
sections.retained_rule: 目的不可理解、故意无或极少 MC、最低质量及零增值

sections.title: Hacked, Defaced, or Spammed Pages
sections.retained_rule: 入侵篡改及大量垃圾评论使原目的失效

sections.title: Expired Domain Abuse
sections.retained_rule: 过期域名滥用定义、常见表现与必要条件的区别及历史核查

sections.title: Site Reputation Abuse
sections.retained_rule: 站点声誉滥用的主要目的条件及七类非自动滥用例外

sections.title: Scaled Content Abuse
sections.retained_rule: 规模化滥用的主要目的、典型低增值表现；编辑不是排除项；多页取证

sections.title: MC Created with Little to No Effort, Little to No Originality, and Little to No Added Value for Website Visitors
sections.retained_rule: 全部或几乎全部复用、投入原创和增值；署名不免责、授权联供例外

sections.title: How to Determine if Content is Copied
sections.retained_rule: 句段搜索、动态旧源、轻改、改写、日期与档案对比

sections.title: Examples of Lowest Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: 核对全部示例，抽取事实错误、身份欺骗、伤害、垃圾及增值边界

sections.title: Low Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: Low 定义、轻度伤害边界、各维度单项足以支持及网站类型无豁免

sections.title: Lacking E-E-A-T
sections.retained_rule: 必要 E-E-A-T 不足不能被声誉或站点类型补偿

sections.title: Low Quality Main Content
sections.retained_rule: 低投入内容、轻度事实错误、标题夸张；普通人艺术分享例外

sections.title: MC is Created with Low Effort, Low Originality and Low Added Value for Website Visitors
sections.retained_rule: 低增值复用与近零增值 Lowest 的界线

sections.title: Filler as a Poor User Experience
sections.retained_rule: filler 的两类 Low 条件：糟糕体验或妨碍查找；有价值背景例外

sections.title: Distracting Ads/SC
sections.retained_rule: 明显干扰、易关闭弹窗例外、性暗示怪诞或耸动的广告 SC 内容

sections.title: Mildly Negative Reputation of the Website or Content Creator
sections.retained_rule: 轻度负面声誉及调查、少量评论和缺乏声誉的限制

sections.title: Unsatisfying Amount of Information about the Website or Content Creator
sections.retained_rule: 目的相关的责任和客服信息不足；别名例外

sections.title: Exaggerated or Mildly Misleading Information about the Website or Content Creator
sections.retained_rule: 轻度夸大与故意显著欺骗的 Low / Lowest 边界

sections.title: Examples of Low Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: 核对所有低质示例；编辑错误、空泛建议、缺步骤、广告及 filler

sections.title: Medium Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: Medium 完整基础条件、适当 MC、声誉及 E-E-A-T

sections.title: Types of Medium Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: 没有问题但不突出与混合质量两条路径及上下边界

sections.title: Examples of Medium Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: 百科、幽默、娱乐、食谱示例不升级为统一内容长度或评论数量门槛

sections.title: High Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: High 基础条件与至少一项突出标准

sections.title: High Quality Main Content
sections.retained_rule: 高 MC 投入原创技能准确性及与平均页面区别

sections.title: Positive Reputation
sections.retained_rule: 主题相关正面声誉，非正式证据、平台归属与无声誉例外

sections.title: High Level of E-E-A-T
sections.retained_rule: 高 E-E-A-T 随目的、主题、经验及信任要求变化

sections.title: Examples of High Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: 核对新闻、官方、幽默、商家、购物、视频、游戏、百科示例，不以形式替代质量

sections.title: Highest Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: Highest 基础条件与至少一项非常突出的标准

sections.title: Very High Quality MC
sections.retained_rule: 新闻、艺术、信息内容的不同最高质量要求

sections.title: Very Positive Reputation
sections.retained_rule: 非常正面声誉，专家推荐／奖项与非 YMYL 证据；无声誉例外

sections.title: Very High Level of E-E-A-T
sections.retained_rule: 独特权威、丰富经验或很高专业能力及主题相关信任

sections.title: Examples of Highest Quality Pages
sections.retained_rule: 核对全部最高示例；登录、PDF、个人经验和艺术亦可最高

sections.title: Page Quality Criteria for Specific Types of Pages
sections.retained_rule: 特殊页面规则按类型适用

sections.title: Ratings for Encyclopedia Pages
sections.retained_rule: 百科站点声誉与条目自身研究、引用、准确性的共同要求

sections.title: Ratings for Pages with Error Messages or No MC
sections.retained_rule: 定制错误页、临时坏页、系统性空内容、真正未加载的不同处理

sections.title: Ratings for Forums and Q&A Pages
sections.retained_rule: 论坛 MC、访客视角、别名、新帖、长期无回复、混合质量及 YMYL 经验

sections.title: Page Quality Rating Tasks
sections.retained_rule: 两个档位取低、三个取中；地域不扣分；非 HTML 与未穷尽情形

sections.title: Instructions for Rating Page Quality Tasks
sections.retained_rule: 前置退出、语言与未加载定义；PQ 网格和评论转为证据记录

sections.title: Page Quality Rating FAQs
sections.retained_rule: 外观不决定、个人意见、YMYL 经验、非正式专业、艺术目的、统一标准与插页

supplement.retained_rule: 地区与文化视角、不以个人偏好评分、未过滤广告的体验、安全浏览、历史示例语境
PQ 不依赖 query；不得将 Needs Met 导航豁免挪用于 PQ
标记依据结果本身，色情及显著色情广告的语境
真正未加载、定制错误页、付费限制、恶意警告的区别；不导入 Needs Met 的 FailsM 映射
可选内容标记不自动决定 PQ
外语定义、英语和当地常用语言豁免、混合语言、联合 NM 的 PQ N/A；不套独立退出
转化为任务语境、字段完整性、无法评价原因记录；不复制平台登录、领任务、提交按钮操作

interpretation: 章节映射验证覆盖索引完整；不等于独立语义认证或评分准确率测试。
